rows.proof: `CAPITAL PROJECT FUNDS FY 2013`, PDF page 76 of the FY2013 annual town report (4119-fy-2013-annual-town-report.pdf), printed folio 72. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, READ OFF THE PAGE AND WRITTEN DOWN (rule 13b.4): `ART #/YR` | `PURPOSE` | `APPROPRIATED FORWARD` | `EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/TRANSFERRED` | `BALANCE`. The page's own legend reads `fwd - forward from FY 12`, `ATM - Annual Town Meeting`, `STM - Special Town Meeting`. THE PAGE IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns fewer than 6 words on every one of this report's 97 pages -- so it was read off the page's own 518 dpi bitmap. No recognition was used. WHAT PROVES IT, two independent things: (1) the 46 project lines sum to the printed `Grand Total` in ALL THREE columns, EXACTLY -- 2,020,003.14 / 1,321,858.73 / 698,144.41, no tolerance declared and none needed; (2) every one of the 46 rows satisfies APPROPRIATED FORWARD less EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/TRANSFERRED equals BALANCE, to the cent, 0 failures, and the Grand Total row satisfies it too. Three rows print no figure in the middle column at all -- `School Feasibility Study`, `Radio Equipment - Fire Department` and `Middle School Whiteboards` -- and for those the page repeats the appropriation as the balance, which is the identity holding with an absent term rather than a figure we supplied. FOUR ROWS PRINT A NEGATIVE in the middle column, in parentheses -- (190.17), (0.33), (4.95) and (1,500.00) -- and are recorded as negative because the identity only closes that way and because the column's own heading includes TRANSFERRED: money moving back out of a project. A ROW'S KEY IS `<ART #/YR> :: <PURPOSE>`, because the purposes are NOT unique -- `Engineer and Construct Sewers`, `Police Cruiser - Police Department` and `Computer Replacement Plan - Technology Dept.` each appear under more than one article and are different appropriations of different years. The `::` and the article prefix are OURS; the article and the purpose are the page's.

rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / TRUST FUNDS / FISCAL YEAR 2013 SUMMARY REPORT`, PDF page 78 of the FY2013 annual town report (printed page 74). THE PAGE IS LANDSCAPE, prints its fund names SIDEWAYS, and has NO TEXT LAYER, so it was rotated upright and read off its own 400 dpi bitmap. THE COLUMN NAMES ARE READ OFF THE PRINTED HEADER AND NOT INFERRED (rule 13b.4). This page is one of the places the handoff recorded as having column names that could not be established; here they are, verbatim, left to right, with the page's own line breaks and its own misspelling of the second one: `FUND NAME` | `BEGINNING BALANCE PRINCIPAL` | `BEGINNNING BALANCE EARNINGS` (three Ns, as printed) | `CONTRIBUTE TO PRINCIPAL` | `NET EARNINGS` | `DISBURSE FROM PRINCIPAL` | `TRANSFERS OF EARNINGS` | `ENDING CASH VALUE` | `UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS` | `ENDING MARKET VALUE`. Nine money columns. Figures printed in parentheses are stored NEGATIVE, as the page prints them. TWO IDENTITIES PER ROW, BOTH DECLARED AND BOTH CLOSING TO THE CENT: the six movement columns make the ending cash value, and the ending cash value plus the unrealized gain or loss makes the ending market value. ACROSS THE WHOLE PAGE that is 22 funds and 44 assertions, all closing. AND THE GROUP SUBTOTAL IS THE CHECK ON THE COLUMNS THE ROW IDENTITIES DO NOT TOUCH -- in particular `UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS`, which appears in only one of the two row identities. All NINE columns of this group foot to the `SUBTOTALS` row the page prints for it, exactly. No tolerance is declared and none was needed. THIS PAGE IS NOT THE WHOLE STATEMENT: PDF page 79 carries the remaining groups and the grand totals, and this file makes no claim about them. THIS FILE IS THE GROUP THE PAGE HEADS `CEMETERY FUNDS`, 3 funds.
